method: Local serial Router/Worker, SQLite and LOCAL artifacts. Per size: A,C before-after; B,D after-before. Each process reads the same accepted growing-topology prefix and executes one new stage and Naming block per height. Fresh test-only result keys, same frozen evaluator version on both arms. OS and DB caches retained. Per-operation SHA-256 checked for BREP, Naming and final GLB, preview Head checked. Engineering runs use normal keys and independent documents, before-after then after-before. Active command wall clock; Worker and service sub-phases are nested. Browser interactions checked separately. No first-frame, GPU or remote IO timing.
